entities.name: Abdul Ghafoor Breshna
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdul Ghafoor Breshna was an Afghan painter, music composer, poet, and film director. He is regarded as one of the country's most talented artists. He also composed the former national anthem of Afghanistan that was used during the 1970s.
